common_required: trial or paid entitlement is active
meta_and_google_ads_required: at least one provider-verified connected account exists
exactly one reporting account is selected and revalidated
klaviyo_required: required metric and journey bindings are complete
Estimated 30-Day Klaviyo Email Spend configuration is complete

initial_bootstrap.rule: The initial bootstrap fetches only yesterday and today. The 14-day trial controls entitlement, not historical fetch depth.

subsequent_runs: refresh today as provisional using idempotent upsert
after provider business-date rollover reconcile yesterday
preserve older rows unless a separately approved provider reconciliation or backfill policy selects them

maturity.finalized_requires: provider-specific current official reporting, attribution and correction-window contract

failure_and_product_behavior.manual_recovery: server-side operator capability only; not a merchant product control in v1

acceptance: Completing a provider setup creates at most one bootstrap job without a page refresh or merchant button.
The bootstrap requests yesterday before today and does not request older history.
A 14-day trial never expands the initial fetch to 14 days.
Multiple Shopify users opening the app cannot create duplicate snapshot jobs.
Hourly jobs are sharded and single-flight by workspace, provider and reporting account.
Today remains provisional; yesterday is not marked finalized until the provider-specific maturity contract permits it.
Failures preserve the last successful dataset and expose safe freshness state.
This contract alone does not activate a production schedule or historical backfill.
